Add mark and unmark logic to Kluso
commitResults.messageBody:
Unmark and mark logic has been added by modifying the Task class and the Kluso class. In previous commits, the Task class has been given a boolean attribute of "isComplete", used to indicate whether or not the task has been completed, and a bracket representation of whether it is complete. The Task class has been changed to add new methods to mark and unmark, by returning a new Task object with identical attributes except for either a true value of "isComplete" or false value of "isComplete", in a side-effect free manner: markAsComplete() and markAsIncomplete() respectively.

Kluso parses the user input, checks to see if it is of the form "mark <int>" or "unmark <int>" where <int> represents any integer, for the mark as complete and mark as incomplete commands respectively, checks if the integer is found as an index number in the list of tasks, and then calls markAsComplete() or markAsIncomplete() respectively on the Task instance in the tasks array which stores all tasks given so far. Kluso takes the new task and stores it in the array, replacing the old task in the same position.

A point of future improvement is to maybe ensure that "mark" and "unmark" are only triggered as commands if an integer follows.

There are two commented-out pieces of test code that should not be included.

Add a deadline class
add provisional deadline, event and java class

commitResults.messageBody:
Todo, Deadline and Event subclasses were added, inheriting from the Task class.

In order to support the use of class methods, moved the class level variables from the main method into the class as static variables.

Wrote a parser method to handle the user inputs of varying length and signatures, and catch most input errors for the appropriate input patterns, for tasks, mark, unmark, todo, deadline and event, in a upper and lower case independent way.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add 'out', 'list' into the parser
Add Todo, Deadline and Event logic for Level 4
commitResults.messageBody: Kluso is now a static class which uses switch statements by length to call static class methods representing each of the actions he is supposed to do in response to user input. Able to catch some erroneous inputs within the mark and unmark task methods (determining if the index to be marked or unmarked is within or outside the task list).

commitResults.messageTitle: write and conduct automated test for Kluso output
Finalise error handling for Level-5
commitResults.messageBody: Finalised the error handling ability for Kluso at Level-5. Tested to be able to catch and other erroneous inputs such as if arguments are lacking, or arguments lack the necessary signatures like the slash for times, or "from" and "to" for Event. Does not catch faulty inputs for "list" and "out", to enable the user to add tasks starting with "list" and "out", in case these tasks exist.

commitResults.messageTitle: Shift files into packages preemptively for cleanliness
Add Java DateTime compatibility
commitResults.messageBody: Added a basic Java DateTime format compatibility, where the input is parsed as a DateTime object, and output in a different display format, per specifications. What is displayed to the user is the display format, which is as required. However, the record file contains the raw format. This is to allow easy parsing with minimal changes from the previous iteration - a separate date time object class, KlusoDateTie, handles all datetime operations, with method calls to it, rather than to any other objects or native libraries.
